response.sql: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL THEN `T-BIL` / CRE ELSE NULL END AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), grouped_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM filtered_data GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall_mean_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_value FROM grouped_stats) SELECT grouped_stats.CENTROMEA, grouped_stats.avg_hgb, grouped_stats.avg_ratio, grouped_stats.avg_ratio / overall_mean_val.mean_value as normalized_ratio FROM grouped_stats, overall_mean_val WHERE overall_mean_val.mean_value IS NOT NULL
